name: Door and Room Schedule Consistency
description: Read-only check of door and room schedules in a saved snapshot: duplicate or missing door Marks, doors with missing or identical From/To rooms, unnumbered or duplicate room numbers, rooms with zero area, and Marks that do not fit a pattern you supply. Proposes unique Marks but never changes the model.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to check. Leave empty only in mock mode.

mark_pattern.description: Optional regular expression every door Mark must fully match, for example the format your office uses. Nothing is assumed; if empty, the pattern check is skipped.

suggest_prefix.description: Optional text to start proposed Marks with. If empty, no Mark proposal is made.

suggest_digits.description: How many digits to pad proposed Mark numbers to (default 3).
